Solar System Energy Lab
In this investigation, you are to travel around our solar system and find the amount of solar energy available at different distances from the sun. You must point your light probe (on the front of your ship) directly at the sun to get the best data possible. The sun, planets, and the ship will have their sizes magnified to help you orient yourself in the solar system, but the distance scales away from the sun will be accurate.

When you are ready to start the experiment, click on the begin button
